This is based on the change of control notice, which states: "We write under Clause 14.2 of the Master Services Agreement dated 2 March 2026 to notify you of an expected change of control of Harrowgate Systems Inc." [1].

Additionally, the Harrowgate MSA specifies that notices should be addressed to the General Counsel of the receiving party. [6].

evidence.quote: We write under Clause 14.2 of the Master Services Agreement dated 2 March 2026 to notify you of an expected change of control of Harrowgate Systems Inc.
Any notice under this Agreement shall be in writing and addressed to the General Counsel of the receiving party at the address set out in Schedule 4.

items.question: Where are the MSA's service levels set out?
items.answer: The MSA's service levels are set out in Schedule 2 of the Harrowgate MSA [1].

evidence.quote: Provider shall provide the Services in accordance with the service levels in Schedule 2.

items.question: How many years does the warehouse lease run for?
items.answer: The warehouse lease runs for ten years. The term of the lease is stated as ten (10) years, starting on 1 April 2025 and ending on 31 March 2035 [3].

evidence.quote: The term is ten (10) years starting on 1 April 2025 and ending on 31 March 2035 (the "Term").

items.question: At which facility does Kestrel store Voss-Lindqvist's equipment?
items.answer:
The documents state that Kestrel stores Voss-Lindqvist's equipment at its Brookfield facility.

[1]

evidence.quote: Provider will store Client's archived equipment at its Brookfield facility.
